Zelensky Says 'All Ukrainian Power Plants Damaged', Appeals for Help as Trump Eyes Russia Deal
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed at the Ibero-American Summit in Madrid that every single power plant in Ukraine has been damaged in one way or another by persistent Russian missile and drone strikes. This desperate appeal comes as U.S. President Donald Trump simultaneously announced a massive, impending agreement with Moscow that could redefine the security architecture of the entire European continent.
